title: Stop reconciliation retries for a terminal pre-broker paper rejection

scheduled_lifecycle_resolver.behavior: Authoritative terminal pre-broker paper order_rejection identities (explicit submitted_to_broker=False, zero/absent fill quantities, no broker/fill/ledger/reconciliation/booking identifiers or uncertain outcome flags, explicit pre-broker risk rejection status, and a single concrete non-expression pre-broker rejection reason) take the existing ineligible branch (reason='lifecycle_noop_order_closed', status='not_eligible', terminal=True, retryable=False, attempt_count=0, event_id=None) instead of falling through to the generic non-position_snapshot lifecycle_in_flight branch.
preserved_invariants: Committed position snapshot precedence is preserved in _paper_lifecycle_identity before inspecting last_lifecycle_identity.
Tenant alignment (summary, identity, correlation_envelope, and metadata) and paper boundaries (summary, identity, correlation_envelope, metadata, and authority_refs) fail closed.

Genuine in-flight stages (signal_generation, trade_decision, risk_evaluation, order_submitted, order_accepted, paper_fill_simulated) and order_rejection records with absent, conflicting, uncertain, broker-submitted, or contradictory fill/booking evidence remain pending (lifecycle_in_flight).
Global no-op order filtering (services/trade_journey/lifecycle_noop_order.py::is_noop_order) is unchanged and returns False for the witnessed order_rejection.

The witnessed rejection tj_79726064-4cc2-5510-8e11-7f5e59ff89bd remains visible in the BFF trade-journeys routes with status='failed', current_stage='risk_evaluation', quantity=452.0, reason_code='insufficient_cash', expression_reason_code='long_cash', submitted_to_broker=False, order_status='not_submitted', reason_detail={required: 100034.3461, available: 100000.0, limit: 100000.0, requested_quantity: 452.0}, and no invented reconciliation stage or fabricated variance/completion.

Independent bindings in the same scheduled pass receive their normal drift/health evaluation and genuine booking reconciliation result (reconciliation_completed or reconciliation_failed with trade-specific checks).

runtime_budget.net_effect_at_hosted_scale: Eliminates 277 false pending lifecycle_in_flight work-claim failures per 24h on bindings whose latest lifecycle event is an authoritative terminal pre-broker paper order_rejection; mints 0 synthetic reconciliation events.
